title: The eraser
body: The basement wall is covered in crossed-out districts. Behind the newest mark is a lens-shaped piece of glass, set into the ledger like an eye.

choices.label: Lift the eraser from the page.

outcome.text: The erased district returns for one breath. You see its streetlights, and the edge of the source beneath them.
The mark changes from a line to a warning. You understand why the clerk wore gloves.
